Rise of the Tomb Raider Cold Darkness Awakened System Requirements

Damn, these recommended requirements have been going through the roof. In the past I could buy a new pc and it would take 2 years for the components to start appearing in the recommended list. Now everything needs a brand new i7 or 980 ti. Have we really advanced so much or is this just poor optimization?

Usually this just means you turn off a few key options, like shadows on ultra, or full scene anti-aliasing. I wouldn't worry about it if you don't meet the "recommended" system requirements. They're basically saying anything that isn't a total potato will run it in some capacity.

Developer / publisher recommended PC system specs seem significantly inflated in the last couple of years I think. Provided you're not playing higher than like 1920x1080 it's usually not a big deal if you don't meet the graphics specs if you turn down stuff like AA or shadow quality a notch which you'll hardly notice. As for RAM, in 2016 you should have 8GB which will be everything you'll ever need for games released so far, and likely for a couple of years to come. Similarly, with CPU specs, most recommendations nowadays list i7 CPUs, but I can think of like a handful of games, at most, that are actually so CPU-bound that an i7 might even make a difference over an i5.

Essentially, not meeting the specs seems to be far less of an issue nowadays than it was years ago.
